title: Surendra — Typeface Design
summary: A digital typeface inspired by historical wood and metal type, developed through glyph design and presented in a custom specimen poster.
meta: Original digital typeface, glyph set, specimen poster

items.label: Project
items.text: Surendra is a type-design project that reinterprets the visual character of historical wood and metal type specimens through a digitally developed typeface and specimen poster. The project connects the physical traditions of historical typography with the possibilities of contemporary digital type design.

items.label: Creative direction
items.text: The project draws inspiration from the visual character of historical printing and display type. Rather than simply reproducing an archival specimen, it explores how historical typographic references can inform a new digital design. The specimen poster presents the typeface as both a functional typographic system and a visual subject in its own right.

items.label: Design approach
items.text: The process includes developing the glyph set and considering spacing, kerning, and consistency across the characters. The specimen poster then demonstrates the typeface through a structured presentation of its forms and visual characteristics.
